Tactical formation: a group order now moves the whole formation, facing the way the leader came, also around corners and with Shift waypoints.
Formation window: redesigned and wider, with a role for every member per formation (experimental), numbered priority places, the Move in formation switch, fixed places for summons and as many members as you like.
Followers keep up with the leader in formation even with Auto Skill off. Only Hold Position keeps a character in place.
Group AI: the party goes into a fight together and acts by its roles.
Forest bandits: every bandit fights in its own way, and they work better together. Small groups now roam the forest on the first levels.
New options in the Delvers menu for bandit patrols and bandit teamwork.
Apocalypse sits between Downfall and Hell when the Hell mod is installed.
Support for the Dungeon Settlers Modded loader. Loader files on GitHub: https://github.com/Fre-yin/DNST-Delvers-Core/releases/tag/v0.5.2
Fixes for dodging, wounds, revive sickness, the aid kit on fallen characters, the second fight on a map, blood marks that stayed on a character and aid kits that could get lost.
